mechanics.claim: Jhin's 4th shot always critically strikes, including against structures.
Jhin cannot declare basic attacks during the reload period.
mechanics.quote: '''Jhin''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks during the reload time.

mechanics.claim: The out-of-combat reload can be interrupted by attacking or casting an ability, unlike the reload after the 4th shot.
mechanics.quote: The latter reload can be interrupted by declaring an attack or casting an ability.

mechanics.claim: The missing-health bonus damage from the 4th shot heals Jhin via lifesteal.
mechanics.quote: The {{as|{{sti|'''missing''' health}}}} damage benefits from {{sti|life steal}}.

mechanics.claim: The missing-health bonus damage does not apply to structures (so is not relevant against turrets, though it does apply against the champion-classified dummy).
mechanics.quote: The '''bonus''' damage based on the target's missing health does not affect structures.

mechanics.claim: Jhin's attack speed is fixed and cannot be increased except by leveling up, and attack speed slows do not affect his bonus AD from the passive.
mechanics.quote: '''Jhin's''' {{sti|{{as|attack speed}}}} cannot increase except by {{sti|xp|leveling}} up, and he deals reduced {{tip|critically strike|critical strike damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Attack damage reductions apply before Jhin's passive AD multiplier, making them proportionally stronger against him.
mechanics.quote: Attack damage reductions apply before the multiplier causing them to be stronger against '''Jhin''' than advertised or versus other champions.
